helpModal.title: Quick Rename Help
helpModal.openBody: Click 'Open Folder' and pick the folder with your files. The browser will ask for permission — grant it to rename files directly.
helpModal.selectBody: Click a file to select it. Use Ctrl+Click to select multiple, Shift+Click for a range, or Ctrl+A to select all.
helpModal.patternBody: Use variables like {name}, {n}, {nn}, {nnn}, {date}, {time}, and {ext}. Example: PPPK_{nnn} produces PPPK_001, PPPK_002, and so on.
helpModal.numberingBody: Pick the starting number, increment (step), and pad (width). Start 10, step 5, pad 3 → 010, 015, 020, 025.
helpModal.findReplaceBody: Enter text to find and an optional replacement. Enable case sensitivity as needed. It applies to file names only and keeps extensions.
helpModal.quotaBody: Free users can rename 5 files, Google users get 10 files, and each token provides 100 successful renames. Only successfully renamed files count against the quota.
helpModal.paymentBody: Buy tokens via DANA or QRIS. Create an order, pay, then submit the proof. The admin verifies it in the app and 100 file units are added to your balance.
helpModal.browserBody: Requires Chrome or Edge on Windows for direct folder renaming (File System Access API). Other browsers use the fallback mode with ZIP downloads.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.filesLocalTitle: Your Files Stay on Your Device
privacy.filesLocalBody: Quick Rename processes your files locally in your browser using the File System Access API. We do not upload, transmit, or store the contents of your files (PDFs, images, documents, archives, or other files) on our servers.
privacy.storedBody: We only store account-related data required to provide the service: your Google profile information (name, email, avatar), your usage quota, token balance, payment orders, and rename metadata (operation ID, time, file count). File names are never required for our service to work.
privacy.authBody: Sign in with Google is handled by Google OAuth. We never receive or store your Google password. We only receive the profile data you agree to share.
privacy.paymentsBody: Payment orders are processed manually by the administrator. You can submit a reference or payment proof that is stored privately and visible only to you and the authorized admin.
privacy.cookiesBody: We use essential cookies to maintain your authentication session and anonymous usage tracking. We do not use tracking cookies for advertising.
privacy.contactBody: For privacy questions, contact the application administrator.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.acceptanceBody: By using Quick Rename, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use this service.
terms.serviceBody: Quick Rename is a bulk file renaming utility that runs in your browser. Your files are processed locally on your device. We are not responsible for the results of the rename operations you perform; please review the preview carefully before applying changes.
terms.quotaBody: Free users receive a limited quota. Users authenticated with Google receive a basic quota. Additional capacity is available through paid tokens. Only successfully renamed files count against the quota. The quota is determined by our server, not by your browser.
terms.purchaseBody: Tokens are purchased via DANA or QRIS and added to your balance after manual verification by the administrator. All token sales are final. Tokens have no expiry.
terms.usageBody: You agree not to attempt to manipulate the quota, token balance, payment status, or administrative access through client-side means, or to otherwise misuse the service.
terms.liabilityBody: Quick Rename is provided "as is" without any warranty. To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for data loss, file corruption, or indirect damages. Always back up important files.
terms.changesBody: We may update these terms from time to time. Continued use of the service constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.
